design_philosophy: A premium, distinctive personal finance dashboard avoiding generic SaaS aesthetics. Focuses on 'Balance-first hierarchy' and calm, confident UI. Uses warm, matte surfaces with high contrast typography to make tracking money feel motivating and elegant.

spacing_and_layout.grid_system: MODE B: THE CONTROL ROOM GRID (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4) with tight gaps (gap-4 or gap-6).
spacing_and_layout.card_padding: p-6 or p-8 for luxurious spacing.
spacing_and_layout.radius: rounded-2xl for an organic, tactile feel.
spacing_and_layout.alignment: Left-align dense content and numbers. Optically align icons inside buttons.

surfaces_and_micro_themes.cards: Flat background, 1px subtle border (border-border), no default shadow. Hover: slight lift (-translate-y-1), subtle shadow-lg, border darkens.
surfaces_and_micro_themes.header: Solid Background (#F4F1ED) with a hard bottom border, or Crystal Glass (backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70) if sticky.
surfaces_and_micro_themes.ai_chat: Solid organic shapes. User bubble in warm sand, AI bubble in deep forest green. No purple/teal AI gradients.

components.buttons: Generous padding, tracking-wide. Primary buttons use deep forest green with bone white text.
components.inputs: Shadcn components heavily customized: 1px border, focus:ring-1 focus:ring-[#1E3A2F] focus:border-[#1E3A2F].
components.charts: Recharts. Line chart for trends (monochrome lines: forest green for income, terracotta for expenses). Pie chart for categories using earthy palette (sage, terracotta, ochre, sand).
components.progress_bars: Custom Shadcn Progress. Background: #E5E0D8, Indicator: #1E3A2F (turn #B84A43 if limit exceeded).

motion_and_interactions.hover_states: Buttons and cards elevate subtly. Text colors explicitly set on hover.
motion_and_interactions.transitions: transition: transform 0.2s ease, border-color 0.2s ease, box-shadow 0.2s ease
motion_and_interactions.chart_animations: Smooth entry animations for pie and line charts.

icons.style: Duotone weight for a high-end, premium feel.

image_urls.description: User profile avatar in the header
Premium 3D wealth illustration for empty states (e.g., no transactions yet) or AI assistant greeting.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a single-page dashboard application. Use Polish language (PLN / zł) for all UI text.
Implement 'Balance-first hierarchy': The main balance should be massive (text-5xl or 6xl) at the top of the dashboard.
Create a modular bento-grid layout for features: Recent Transactions, Monthly Budget Limits, Expenses Breakdown (Pie Chart), and Recurring Subscriptions.

Integrate an AI chat component (floating or embedded) for financial advice. Style it using the earthy color palette (no purple/teal). Use the 'empty_state_illustration' for the AI's avatar or empty state.
Ensure all interactive elements and key text nodes include data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='main-balance', data-testid='add-transaction-btn', data-testid='ai-chat-input').
Customize Shadcn UI heavily to match the Organic & Earthy palette. Remove default Vercel-like styles.
Use Recharts for the financial data visualization. Apply the custom color palette to the charts.
Ensure the UI feels 'calm and premium' with generous padding (p-6, p-8) and soft radii (rounded-2xl) for cards.
Use .js/.jsx extensions for components, strictly adhering to standard React usage.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure APCA/WCAG AA contrast ratios, especially for the light background and muted text elements.
accessibility.focus: All actionable items must have high-contrast focus rings (focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#1E3A2F] focus:ring-offset-2).
